note: nextpnr-himbaechel placement of gowin-gw1n1-blkselhide.fs, read off NEXTPNR_BEL of every placed cell. This file is the ORACLE for "a block memory is here": gowin_unpack finds a BSRAM only where the BSRAM_SP table decodes non-empty, which is exactly the blind spot this design was built to expose, and it reports 0 memories for this bitstream.
